summary: Verified iteration 30 features end-to-end on preview: (1) END badge renders on live Job Map for pole with end_path=true (red divIcon .end-path-badge visible next to UIP2, span skipped between UIP2 and next item); (2) Job Map Download button produces a real file download (UI_TEST_ITER30_pole_map.png) with connections/end-path present, no browser tab opened, no console errors; (3) ASE 'Date of site visit' now uses shadcn calendar popover — clicking the button opens the calendar, picking day 15 sets 07/15/2026 on the trigger and PUT/GET /api/jobs/{id}/ase-data confirms YYYY-MM-DD persistence; (4) Excel bulk import — GET /api/import/template returns valid .xlsx with 'Poles' + 'Underground' sheets and exact headers; Import dialog opens from Add ▸ Import from Excel; Download template button is a file download (pole_import_template.xlsx), not a new tab; add mode imported 2 poles + 1 UG and skipped the bad row (errors=[missing Pole #]), items appeared in Job Detail list; replace mode showed red warning, wiped previous items (including seed items), left exactly 2 poles + 1 UG. Regression: previous End Path/connection behavior still intact.
critical_code_review_comments: poleMapImage.js duplicates computeConnectionPairs / end_path-break logic that also lives in JobMap.jsx (~line 855-1055). Both branches were verified consistent for this iteration, but future changes to connection ordering / end_path semantics must be applied in BOTH files to keep the live map and the downloaded exhibit in sync.
poleMapImage.js is >1200 lines and mixes single-image download, ZIP-page generator and helpers; consider splitting into map-image-single.js / map-image-zip.js for maintainability.

import_excel.py: replace mode also wipes /api/connections for the job — good; note that /api/jobs/{job_id}/import-excel currently accepts no auth (matches other pole/underground endpoints), so any client who knows a job_id can bulk-mutate its data. Not a regression, but worth reviewing across the pole/underground endpoint family.
